messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to notify you that Associated Bank carries out client details confirmation procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'If you want to get your ad back up and running you need to optimize the campaign to improve the CTR.', 'To address this, Standard Bank has released a 128-bit SSL update for the online banking page that eliminates this bug.', 'Microsoft Windows Update', 'We are an Indian based Web Services Company with a primary focused on MOBILE APPLICATION SEO SERVICES WEB DEVELOPMENT AT AFFORDABLE PRICES.', 'Every single Windows installation needs to be accompanied by a valid email for proper verification purpose.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
